entry_points.text: Init walks the table, prepares sync data, dispatches sync/async by flag, logs aggregates and returns retry to avoid retention. Exit is inert.

Ref load runs timer allocation, polled completion, teardown surfacing retained items, plus double release for warnings. Parman load validates sorting; hash load derives counts, gates workers, covers timing, limits, dups, successor. Unloads inert.
Base load flips companions; branch load validates; unloads inert. Sysctl unload frees bitmap, unregisters populated slots. UBSan load runs main-table probes; divide probe never auto-runs.

hazards.text: Filling to the configured maximum must succeed while any insertion beyond it fails with too-big; any other outcome means broken limits.
Probes deliberately trigger wrapping add/sub/mul, negation, truncation, out-of-range shifts, guarded out-of-bounds indexes, invalid bool/enum payloads and unaligned stores.

invariants.text: Alloc wrappers count zeroed successes and freed sizes, null-tolerant, so deltas reveal leaks. Pools size to possible CPUs times eight, atomic if small else blocking. Init sets gate plus completions; report skips idle CPUs and aggregates hits/misses. Table spans sync/async and sizes with mode-indexed init/fini.

Parman arrays need positional identity, count agreement, ordered priorities, small idle tail. Hash uses id mod ten with diff compare; dup params add custom ops, hint 128, no shrink. Insert retries on busy, optionally nomem. Even positions present, odd absent; walks, dumps, successor, worker checks must agree with counts.

Toggle is pure, once per distinct control. Match flag starts true, clears permanently on constant mismatch. Writable 0644, match 0444, int limits 0..100, bitmap 65536. Sysctl logs carry module prefix. Vmalloc outstanding atomic signals completion once at zero.

locks.text: Workers block on the read gate until release; count plus completion signals finish, stop flag ends loops. Async thread path drops preemption around reclaim; timer path omits it.
Lookups/walks run under read-side guard with walk lifecycle and yields; dumps take exclusive guard. Startup barrier shares an atomic counter woken by the last arriver; interrupted wait fails.

state_machines.text: Timer setup rejects zero period else registers a monotonic relative timer; start/stop no-op when disabled. Handler quits on stop, else runs timer worker, advances one cycle, restarts. Bulk pops to depth then recycles validated owners in reverse with hit/miss counts.

Sync run pins a thread per online CPU under held gate, releases after settling, sleeps, stops, waits, tears down, reports; spawn failures log only, null pops are miss. Async mirrors it with RCU finalizer asserting stop; release validates linkage and frees.

Create allocates harness, sizes array to base, creates library, seeds randomness, assigns priorities/items, sets budget, unwinding on failure. Destroy removes items and frees all. Resize reallocates with zeroed tail; move shifts a span clearing source.

Randomness seeds fixed; priorities reject zero/dups until unique. Run walks items cyclically, refreshing bulk/idle from random bits; idle skips, unused added, used removed. First addition error aborts.
Timer callback allocates the initial slot in atomic context and signals completion for loader polling before teardown.

Branch checks mixed controls, flips each, rechecks inverted, restores, rechecks, failing on mismatch. Sysctl validates constants, nested register/unregister, mount rejection, empty layering, unsigned trials with only valid accepted. Vmalloc spans random align/size, bit sweep, busy mixes, hole reuse, huge, non-blocking; null fails cleanly.
Workers share a startup barrier, spawn failures tolerated; after join and free, a secondary check runs at one sixteenth size and started/failed/outcome report.

structs.text: Per-CPU record holds pool/test refs, worker, timer, bulks, delay, counters, stats, duration; init clears then installs refs and settings. Element has owner, number, refcount, 32-word payload. Context embeds pool head, test ref, buffer, RCU head. One record per CPU; compact is element size, large 512.

Priority wrapper pairs object with value; item pairs object with owner/flag; harness holds handle, array, tables, random state, budgets, live count. Shifts give 128 priorities, 8192 items, wrap masks. Base 256, step 128, bulk 512, budget items by 256; list-sort selected; logs carry prefix.

Ref test holds directory, 20 tracker slots with per-index alloc wrappers, timer, flag. Hash values carry id/tag; objects pair values with nodes; worker ctx has count/tag/task/array; two global tables per run. Cap 1M, 50k entries, 4 runs, autosize, no shrink, hint 8, 10 workers, max-int sentinel, no nomem retry.
Eight base controls span old/new forms and true/false, each with a load-flipped companion. Record pairs expected value, control ref and probe.
Storage groups scalars, four-int vector, boot/unsigned ints, 65-char string, bitmap pointer. Entries bind name, storage, length, mode, handler, limits; six usable header slots.
Probes are parameterless routines in a load-iterated main table plus a retained table for the excluded divide probe. Helper publishes a static as read-only parameter with text.
